name: dungeon
description: Adventure sites, ruins, lairs, and hostile complexes

fields.Name: Buried Temple
fields.Description: collapsed sacred chambers surrounding a sealed altar that still receives offerings.

fields.Name: Bandit Cavern
fields.Description: natural tunnels expanded with barricades, storerooms, cells, and hidden exits.

fields.Name: Ruined Fortress
fields.Description: broken walls above intact arsenals, command tunnels, and forgotten defenders.

fields.Name: Ancient Crypt
fields.Description: family tombs, funerary traps, ancestral records, and disturbed sealed chambers.

fields.Name: Wizard's Tower
fields.Description: stacked laboratories where failed experiments have altered gravity and space.

fields.Name: Sunken Palace
fields.Description: flooded halls accessible during low tide, through diving, or by ancient pumps.

fields.Name: Monster Warren
fields.Description: interconnected nests shaped by generations of increasingly large inhabitants.

fields.Name: Collapsed City District
fields.Description: buried streets and homes connected through basements and sinkholes.

fields.Name: Cursed Manor
fields.Description: a noble residence repeating the final night before its household's destruction.

fields.Name: Volcanic Shrine
fields.Description: heat-blasted tunnels, sacrificial bridges, lava channels, and fireproof guardians.

fields.Name: Frozen Tomb
fields.Description: ice-preserved halls where opening doors releases ancient air, disease, and occupants.

fields.Name: Cult Sanctuary
fields.Description: disguised meeting rooms descending into ritual chambers and an unfinished summoning site.

fields.Name: Living Dungeon
fields.Description: an enormous organism whose chambers digest intruders and rearrange like organs.

fields.Name: Dream Prison
fields.Description: a mental complex entered through sleep, with exits hidden in prisoners' memories.

fields.Name: Inverted Tower
fields.Description: a structure descending into the earth while gravity points toward its distant roof.

fields.Name: Planar Embassy
fields.Description: an abandoned diplomatic complex built for visitors with incompatible bodies and physics.

fields.Name: Clockwork Vault
fields.Description: precise mechanical rooms that reset traps and rotate corridors on a fixed schedule.

fields.Name: Worldroot Hollow
fields.Description: primeval tunnels inside a colossal root system infected by a spreading corruption.

fields.Name: Astral Observatory
fields.Description: a remote ruin whose lenses open physical paths toward dangerous celestial objects.

fields.Name: Forgotten Ruins
fields.Description: Unstable remains of an abandoned domain, still protected by traps, guardians, or oaths.

fields.Name: Condemned Mine
fields.Description: Galleries abandoned after an accident whose official cause contradicts the traces below.

fields.Name: Inhabited Cave
fields.Description: A natural network adapted by a creature, a community, or fugitives.

fields.Name: Decommissioned Prison
fields.Description: Cells, archives, and service passages preserve evidence of a detention erased from history.

fields.Name: Ancient Sewers
fields.Description: A network larger than the present city, linking cisterns, crypts, and forbidden foundations.

fields.Name: Desecrated Cemetery
fields.Description: Open graves and displaced monuments surround a vault someone is trying to reach.

fields.Name: Anomalous Crater
fields.Description: A recent depression where stone, magic, or time behaves differently.

fields.Name: Ruined Sanctuary
fields.Description: An abandoned chapel or temple whose rites still produce effects without an officiant.
